question.prompt: A square and a triangle have equal perimeters. The lengths of the three sides of the triangle are \(6.1\) cm, \(8.2\) cm and \(9.7\) cm. What is the area of the square in square centimeters?

solutions.explanation:
The equal perimeters let us use the triangle's sides to find the square's perimeter:
\[
6.1+8.2+9.7=24\text{ cm}.
\]
A square has four equal sides, so each side is \(24\div4=6\) cm. Its area is therefore
\[
6\times6=\boxed{36}\text{ cm}^2,
\]
which is choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Find the side from the common perimeter
